judgement.summary: The system failed to complete the task as it did not execute the migration and validation steps, only creating a plan without implementation.

The system maintained its role as a planning and coordination agent.
There was no repetition of steps in the trace.
The system maintained context throughout the interaction.
The system marked the task as in progress and did not terminate after creating the plan, which was not the task's completion.
The conversation did not reset unexpectedly.
The system did not ask for missing details such as file paths or acceptance criteria, which were underspecified.
The system stayed focused on creating a migration plan.
There was no indication of withholding information.
There was no input from other agents to ignore.
The actions matched the reasoning provided, which was to create a plan.
